clauses.name: Shababba, Divining Cube
clauses.printedParagraph: As long as Shababba is in the Interzone, at the end of the turn look at the top 4 cards of your deck, then distribute any number of those cards on the top and bottom of your deck in any order.
clauses.expectedBehavior: Only an Interzone Shababba triggers at end of turn; it exposes exactly the top four cards of its controller's Deck and applies the chosen top and bottom order.

clauses.name: Glimpse the Omens
clauses.printedParagraph: Look at the top 4 cards of your deck. Distribute any number of those cards on the top and on the bottom of your deck in any order, then draw 1 card.
clauses.expectedBehavior: Glimpse exposes exactly the top four cards of its controller's Deck, applies any valid top and bottom order, then draws the new top card.

clauses.name: Tut, Rhythmic Whirlwind
clauses.printedParagraph: As long as Tut is on the field, you may pay 🔘: Look at the top 3 cards of your deck. Put one on the bottom of your deck and the others on top of your deck in any order.
clauses.expectedBehavior: Tut's field activation spends one Hollow Essence, exposes up to three cards, and requires exactly two on top and one on the bottom when three are available.

clauses.name: Dissect
clauses.printedParagraph: Look at the top 3 cards of each player's deck. Distribute any number of those cards on the top and bottom of their owner's deck in any order.
clauses.expectedBehavior: Dissect exposes the top three cards of every player's Deck and commits every owner's chosen top and bottom order atomically.

clauses.name: Eviscerate Morality
clauses.printedParagraph: Look at the top 4 cards of your deck. Distribute any number of those cards on the top and bottom of your deck in any order, then discard 2 cards from the top of your deck.
clauses.expectedBehavior: Eviscerate Morality exposes exactly the top four cards of its controller's Deck, applies the chosen order, then discards the resulting top two cards.

limits: This proof certifies the five printed reorder clauses, their legal choice shape and their first authoritative continuation.
It does not re-certify generic Deck privacy, reconnect persistence or unrelated draw and discard replacement families.
